text: 创业板指跌超5%，科创50指数跌超6%，沪指跌1.98%，深成指跌3.99%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人、创新药等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4900只
text_en: ChiNext fell over 5%, STAR 50 fell over 6%, Shanghai Composite down 1.98%, Shenzhen Component down 3.99%, with computing hardware, semiconductor chips, robotics, and innovative drugs leading declines; nearly 4,900 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
